answer: Each identity posts one signed work proof per epoch to the public knoll ledger, locking a 100 copper bond behind it. A second, contradictory proof from the same identity inside the same horizon burns 30 copper of that bond and freezes it for one epoch, the burn shared with the challenger. The k-th fake identity still needs its own 100 copper bond and proof, so 1,000 fakes lock 100,000 copper and expose 30,000 to burning, with no bulk discount. A rented stake fails the same way: the slash lands on the bond. An honest agent posts one proof and keeps its bond and full share.
